sentences.en: We cannot necessarily see the star with the naked eye.
sentences.zh: 我们不一定能用肉眼看到那颗星。

sentences.en: Craft must have clothes, but truth loves to go naked.
sentences.zh: 作品需要包装，但真理喜欢赤裸裸地呈现。

sentences.en: My little brother ran through the living room stark naked.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟光着身子跑过了客厅。

senses.zh: 裸体的，赤裸的；无遮蔽的，暴露的；赤裸裸的，明显的；单纯的，纯粹的
